basics.name: Christian Henning
basics.label: Machine Learning Researcher & R&D Lead
basics.summary: Machine learning researcher and engineer with a PhD from ETH Zurich (continual learning, Bayesian deep learning). At Ethon, took a computer-vision product from prototype to global deployment as product owner, then made the case for a dedicated R&D function, built it, and led it — while writing about what it takes to bring ML from research to production. Now a Machine Learning Delivery Consultant at AWS Professional Services.

work.name: AWS
work.summary: Part of AWS Professional Services. Helping organizations design, build, and deploy production machine learning systems.
highlights: Partner with customers to bring ML from prototype to production
Bridge research-grade methods and real-world delivery constraints

work.name: Ethon
work.summary: Lead the R&D function and shape the technical direction of Ethon's visual inspection product — bridging research, a full-stack product rebuild, and cross-product strategy.
highlights: Oversee the rebuild of Ethon's visual inspection product from on-premise to a cloud-native architecture, orchestrating across product design, infrastructure, and ML
Set the research agenda and drive results into the product — including training-free visual inspection (no per-product model training), now shaping the vision
Work to unify Ethon's product lines and capture cross-product synergies, weighing commercial alongside technical trade-offs
Rethink how applications are distributed and kept up to date across edge deployments, easing delivery bottlenecks — with ethon-cli as one concrete outcome
Mentor research scientists and engineers, and help grow the team

work.name: Ethon
work.summary: Established Ethon's R&D function, defining its mission and processes for innovation in visual industrial AI. Enabled collaboration between research and engineering.
highlights: Designed R&D processes for scientific exploration
Built infrastructure for rapid experimentation
Aligned research with product strategy

work.name: Ethon
work.summary: Led the development of an AI-powered product for industrial anomaly detection, balancing software engineering, algorithmic innovation, and cross-functional leadership.
highlights: Owned the visual-inspection product now scaled to global deployment at customers including Siemens — featured in the World Economic Forum's Proof over Promise report (2026)
Delivered production-grade reliability, with no unplanned line stoppages reported across nearly three years of live deployment
Defined and owned product roadmap in close collaboration with end-users
Led a cross-functional team of up to seven across engineering, research, and QA, coordinating delivery across the product
Actively contributed to hiring and onboarding across the organization
Spoke on the Innovator Stage at the AI+X Summit 2024, a leading Swiss AI conference, on Ethon's manufacturing AI

work.name: Ethon
work.summary: Joined as one of the first employees at Ethon, playing a pivotal role in the initial development of its computer vision product stack.
highlights: Worked across backend, frontend, ML model development, DevOps, and QA
Built and deployed early prototypes used in pilot deployments
Collaborated closely with customers to shape feature development and UX

work.name: ETH Zurich
work.summary: PhD in machine learning and computational neuroscience, working in an interdisciplinary environment.
highlights: Focus on continual learning and Bayesian neural networks
Published at conferences such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML.
Teaching and infrastructure development

courses: Thesis: 'Knowledge uncertainty and lifelong learning in neural systems'
Completed the interdisciplinary ZNZ Neuroscience Center Zurich doctoral program
Focus on Human-Computer-Interaction, Systems-Engineering and Theoretical Computer Science
